title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Matthew Stafford held in check in Week 12 win over Packers
items.desc: Matthew Stafford completed 16-of-23 pass attempts for 140 yards and one interception in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Stafford relied on a dominant Rams rushing attack Wednesday night, passing for under 200 yards for the third time in his last five games. The quarterback will hope to get the Los Angeles passing attack back on track with the potential return of wideout Davante Adams for a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Blake Corum dominates on ground in Week 12 win over Packers
items.desc: Blake Corum carried the ball 32 times for 184 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in two of his three targets for 21 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Corum has taken advantage of increased touches out of the Los Angeles backfield of late, finishing with over 50 offensive yards and rushing for one touchdown in each of his last five games. The running back has offered fantasy managers an impactful backfield option while wrestling touches away from Kyren Williams, with a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kyren Williams reaches end zone in Week 12 win over Packers
items.desc: Kyren Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Williams maximized his role while being out-touched 34-16 by Blake Corum Wednesday night, reaching the end zone for at least once for the fifth time in his last eight games. The running back faces a stiff test in Week 13 against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Konata Mumpfield leads pass-catchers in Week 12 win over Packers
items.desc: Konata Mumpfield hauled in four of his team-leading five targets for 69 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Mumpfield has taken advantage of a larger pass-catching role of late, logging over 60 receiving yards in each of his last two games. The wideout could be pushed back to a WR2 role with the potential return of Davante Adams entering a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Higbee (chest) quiet before exiting in Week 12
items.desc: Tyler Higbee caught one of his three targets for 14 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Higbee has made minimal impact on offense of late, recording under 60 receiving yards in each of his last seven games. The tight end's status will need to be monitored after exiting the win with a chest injury, with a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Colby Parkinson quiet in Week 12
items.desc: Colby Parkinson caught both of his targets for a loss of one yard in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12.
items.impact: Parkinson has underwhelmed in the Los Angeles offense of late, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in eight of nine contests. The tight end could be in line for increased snaps heading into a Week 13 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs after both Tyler Higbee and Davis Allen suffered injuries in the Week 12 win.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Davis Allen catches two passes in Week 12
items.desc: Davis Allen caught both of his targets for 14 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12.
items.impact: Allen has underwhelmed on offense of late, finishing with under 25 receiving yards in each of his 11 games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Xavier Smith sees three touches in Week 12
items.desc: Xavier Smith caught his only target for four yards while also rushing twice for 11 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12.
items.impact: Smith has struggled to make an impact in limited action of late, logging one reception or less in three of his last four contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rams D/ST forces three turnovers in Week 12
items.desc: The Rams D/ST forced three turnovers (one fumble recovery, two interceptions) while also registering one sack in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12.
items.impact: The defense held the Green Bay offense in check, allowing just 244 offensive yards in the win. The unit faces a much stiffer test entering a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brandon McManus racks up 14 points in Week 12
items.desc: Brandon McManus converted all four of his field goal attempts as well as both of his extra point attempts to finish with 14 points in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12.
items.impact: McManus has been dynamic of late, connecting on all 16 of his attempts while recording eight or more points in each of his last three contests. The kicker will look to remain hot entering a Week 13 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jordan Love disappoints in Week 12 loss to Rams
items.desc: Jordan Love completed 17-of-29 pass attempts for 198 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while also rushing once for seven yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Love has struggled behind center of late, passing for less than 250 yards while throwing one or more interceptions in each of his last two games. The quarterback will look to get back on track against the New Orleans Saints in Week 13.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Christian Watson (concussion) lone bright spot before exiting in Week 12
items.desc: Christian Watson (concussion) hauled in all four of his targets for 65 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Watson continues a reliable stretch in the Green Bay offense, finishing with 50 or more receiving yards in six of his last seven games. The wideout remains one of the few dynamic pass-catching options as part of an inconsistent Green Bay offense that will look to take advantage of an extended break to clear through concussion protocols ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Matthew Golden quiet in Week 12 loss to Rams
items.desc: Matthew Golden hauled in just one of his team-leading five targets for 39 yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Golden was held in check by a physical Los Angeles secondary, finishing under 70 receiving yards for the first time in his last four contests. The wideout remains one of the more impactful pass-catching options in an inconsistent Green Bay offense entering a Week 13 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tucker Kraft hauls in three passes in Week 12 loss to Rams
items.desc: Tucker Kraft hauled in three of his five targets for 24 yards while also losing a fumble in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Kraft has struggled to make an impact on offense of late, finishing with less than 45 receiving yards in each of his last three games. The tight end continues to frustrate fantasy managers with inconsistent output in the Green Bay passing attack to this point, with a Week 13 matchup against the New Orleans Saints up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kaleb Johnson bottled up in Week 12 loss to Rams
items.desc: Kaleb Johnson rushed eight times for 13 yards while also hauling in one of his two targets for 19 yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Johnson struggled to find running room against a stout Los Angeles front seven, finishing with under 40 rushing yards for the first time in his last three games. The running back will look to find success against the New Orleans Saints in Week 13 if Josh Jacobs (finger) remains sidelined.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd dismal out of backfield in Week 12 loss
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd rushed once for 10 yards while also catching his only target for six yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Lloyd has been dismal out of the backfield to this point, finishing with less than 40 offensive yards in each of his 10 games. The running back is best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Savion Williams sees three touches in Week 12
items.desc: Savion Williams hauled in one of his three targets for three yards while also rushing twice for a team-high 18 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: Williams has underwhelmed in the Green Bay offense of late, recording under 50 offensive yards in all seven of his games. The wideout remains another inconsistent option that is best left off rosters in all formats entering a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chris Brooks sees five touches in Week 12
items.desc: Chris Brooks rushed once for four yards while also catching four of his five targets for 22 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: Brooks has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield when active, recording less than 40 offensive yards in each of his seven contests. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bo Melton sees three touches in Week 12
items.desc: Bo Melton rushed once for three yards while also catching two of his three targets for 20 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: Melton has offered minimal impact on offense of late, finishing under 25 offensive yards in all 11 contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: J. Michael Sturdivant sees one target in Week 12
items.desc: J. Michael Sturdivant failed to catch his only target in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: Sturdivant has seen minimal involvement on offense of late, finishing with one reception or less in seven of his last eight contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats entering a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Packers D/ST disappoints in Week 12
items.desc: The Packers D/ST recorded one turnover (one interception) while also registering one sack in a 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: The defense was victimized by a physical Rams ground attack, allowing 241 rushing yards in the loss. The unit will look to get back on track against an inconsistent New Orleans Saints offense in Week 13.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Trey Smack racks up seven points in Week 12
items.desc: Trey Smack converted both of his field goal attempts as well as his only extra point attempt in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: Smack has fallen victim to inconsistent offensive play of late, recording five points or less in three of his last six contests. The kicker will hope for a more prolific performance in Week 13 against the New Orleans Saints.
